role: ICARUS Claude Opus 4.8 non-authoring S3 preflight evidence judge
non_blocking_risks: Timing margin: provider fuses are fixed wall-clock (stop 2026-07-27T16:35Z, terminate/delete 16:45Z). The 43,200s (12h) production run plus setup and retrieval must finish before the stop fuse; the retry-clock deadline was removed while the fuse stayed fixed, so if A04 creation/setup slips much past ~04:00-04:35Z the stop fuse can interrupt the soak. Outcome remains safe (cost capped at $3.00 aggregate, teardown guaranteed via three redundant mechanisms) but the single authorized production attempt could be wasted.

AWS session dependency: the coordinator relies on the freshly refreshed short-lived AWS session for 12 hourly cloud calls (last call ~hour 11) across the 12h soak. If the SSO/STS session expires before the final call the coordinator fails closed and the soak is left incomplete. CockroachDB uses a static keychain password fetched per call and is not affected.

Disclosed cryptographic limitations: first-use (TOFU) SSH host-key pinning rather than provider-signed attestation, and no provider image-digest readback on this CPU Pod surface. Mitigations (two byte-identical key scans; preserved creation request, registry digest, and runtime uname/os-release/binary hashes) are best-effort only, as the packet itself acknowledges.

Trial diversity: the 12 requests reuse the two fixed P9 task IDs (promote/refuse, 6x each) with per-request cleanup rather than 12 distinct scenarios. Adequate for a sustained-operation soak but not 12 unique cases.
evidence_gaps: AWS session time-to-live relative to the 12h soak (and to the ~hour-11 final cloud call) is not stated; sufficiency for all 12 hourly invocations is unverified.

Threshold derivation is asserted as coming from S1/S2/P9 evidence, but the worker runs the S2 foundation soak for 43,200s (12h) whereas the cited S2 production measurement (peak RSS 836,284,416 bytes) was a 6h run; the 12h-scaled measurements behind the 1.5 GiB RSS and 16 MiB evidence-growth ceilings are not included for independent verification.
S3_RUNTIME_HASHES_R1.json carries no self-hash, so its internal consistency (it references the R11 schedule hash 4d8cebd3 while retaining an R1 label) cannot be cross-checked from within the packet.
fake_runpodctl.py, invoked by prove_coordinator_guard.py, is absent from the runtime hash manifest (test-only helper; the production path uses the hash-pinned /tmp/runpodctl-v2.7.2).
